text:
maya (marketing): Hey runtime team—preparing launch post and webinar narrative. We need a short, focused audit of benchmark sample coverage and warmup vs cold-start deltas. Can you run a targeted sweep and hand back raw artifacts + a one-paragraph takeaway? :pray:

josh (eng-runtime): Yep. Can you list exact slices you care about and targets (p50/p95 latency, cost per token) so we can scope?

maya (marketing): Top priority slices: 1) short prompts (<=64 tokens) 2) mid (256) 3) long (2048) 4) interactive chat pattern (frequent small exchanges) 5) embedding-style single calls. For each we want: cold vs warm p50/p95, quantized vs fp16 delta, and raw token-level logs for 1000 samples. Target p95 thresholds for slides: short <60ms, mid <150ms, long <600ms. Cost numbers for slide footnotes OK as ballpark.

sam (eng-runtime): Ok. Two clarifying Qs: a) do you need cross-region (us-west/us-east/eu) runs or just us-west? b) do we require stable seed/repro tags on payloads?

maya (marketing): Keep it to us-west and us-east (EU optional). Yes include reproducible seed + manifest file so we can attach provenance. Also please include any failures and explanation for high tail cases we can quote.

josh (eng-runtime): Cool. We'll run with current stable model variants + our quantized profile q8_0 and fp16 baseline. We'll do 1k samples per slice, concurrency profile matching realistic traffic (burst 8, sustained 2), and capture cold-warm by measuring first N requests after idle and after warm-up window.

liz (product-marketing): If possible, add an 8-sample interactive demo transcript per slice we can reuse in the webinar. Short snippets only.

josh (eng-runtime): Noted. We'll include the demo transcripts. I have a quick run command I'll kick off and link artifacts here when done:

```bash
# run profile: sample-sweep
python tools/run_sweep.py --slices short,mid,long,chat,embed --samples 1000 --concurrency-burst 8 --concurrency-sustained 2 --quant-profiles q8_0,fp16 --regions us-west,us-east --seed 42 --output /tmp/marketing_sweep_1755551234
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled job started: marketing-sweep-1755551234. ETA ~45m.

maya (marketing): Awesome. Can you remind us of the artifact manifest fields you will attach? We need to know what to reference in docs.

sam (eng-runtime): We'll include: run_id, slice_name, region, model_variant, quant_profile, seed, sample_count, raw_logs_path (token-level), aggregated_metrics.csv (p50/p95/cost), demo_transcripts.json, repro_manifest.txt. All attached as .tar.gz.

maya (marketing): Perfect. Request: please prioritize the short & chat slices first if the full sweep overruns. Those are our headline slides.

josh (eng-runtime): Will do. I'll post the artifact links and a one-paragraph executive takeaway once the sweep finishes. Expect update ~ +50m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liz (product-marketing): Thanks — will prep slide templates to drop numbers into.

deploy-bot: job marketing-sweep-1755551234: stage=running progress=20%

maya (marketing): tagging @josh @sam — appreciate fast turnaround. If obvious regressions appear vs last-quarter numbers, flag asap so we can rework messaging. :warning:

josh (eng-runtime): Understood. We'll raise any regression alerts in this thread.

deploy-bot: job marketing-sweep-1755551234: stage=completed status=success artifacts=/runs/marketing_sweep_1755551234/marketing_sweep_1755551234.tar.gz

josh (eng-runtime): Sweep finished. Artifacts uploaded: https://storage.internal/runs/marketing_sweep_1755551234/marketing_sweep_1755551234.tar.gz

sam (eng-runtime): Quick exec summary: short/chat p95 well under targets on fp16; q8_0 adds ~12–18% p95 on short prompts but cost drops ~30%. Long-context p95 increased more with q8_0 (~25%) but still within acceptable story if we call out quantization tradeoff. Attached aggregated_metrics.csv and a short note on high-tail causes.

maya (marketing): This is gold. I'll pull the numbers into the launch deck. Can you paste the 2–3 sentence summary we can use in slide copy?

josh (eng-runtime): Suggested copy: "In our launch tests, quantized variants reduced per-token cost by ~30% while increasing p95 latency by 12–25% depending on context length. For short and interactive workloads we observe minimal impact to perceived responsiveness, making quantized variants a strong cost-performance option for bursty products."

maya (marketing): love it. Thanks team. We'll draft the launch blog and webinar slides and tag you for fact-checks. :rocket:
